content:
In this second exercise of our OpenAI Image Project series, we’ll build on what we learned in Exercise 1 and dive into generating content — specifically an essay on the topic of "Computer Vision."

By using OpenAI's gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 model, you'll see just how powerful and fluent language generation can be with just a few lines of Python code.

🚀 What You’ll Learn

  • How to send a prompt to the OpenAI API
  • How to get a complete essay written by the model
  • How to handle API authentication using a secure key
  • How to print the generated content to your terminal

✅ Full Code (Copy, Paste & Run)

Here's the full working script. Make sure you have openai installed and your API key ready:

# Exercise 2

from openai import OpenAI
from apikey import apikey
import os

# Set up API key for authentication
os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY'] = apikey
OpenAI.api_key = apikey

# Create OpenAI client
client = OpenAI()

# The essay prompt
prompt = "Write an essay on 'Computer Vision'"

# Send prompt to OpenAI's chat API
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-3.5-turbo-0125",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]
)

# Print the response
print("Response")
print(response.choices[0].message.content)

🧩 Setting Up apikey.py

To keep your API key secure and cleanly separated from the main script, follow these steps:

  1. Create a file named apikey.py in the same directory as your script.
  2. Paste the following code into that file:
apikey = "your_openai_api_key_here"

💡 Replace "your_openai_api_key_here" with your actual OpenAI API key.

🧪 Sample Output

Once the script is executed, you'll see an output like this in your terminal:

Response
Computer Vision: Unlocking Machines' Eyes

Computer vision is a subfield of artificial intelligence focused on enabling machines to interpret and process visual information from the world around them. It mimics human vision but with the power of data, algorithms, and processing capabilities that far exceed human speed...

[Essay continues...]

⚠️ Note: Actual output may vary slightly depending on model responses.

💡 Why This Is Useful

This script is perfect for:

  • Learning AI-generated writing
  • Academic research assistance
  • Quick content drafts
  • Exploring prompt engineering

You can change the topic in the prompt variable to generate essays on anything — from biology to blockchain!

💬 Customization Ideas

  • 🔁 Generate multiple responses using a loop
  • 🧪 Compare results across different model versions
  • ✍️ Add a GUI or web interface for topic input

🛠 Troubleshooting

If you encounter any issues:

  • Ensure you’ve installed the openai package:
  pip install openai
  • Make sure your apikey.py file is correctly formatted and in the same directory
  • Double-check that your API key is active at: https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys

🧠 Final Thoughts

With just a few lines of code, you’ve created an intelligent essay generator powered by OpenAI. This opens the door to automating blog writing, building educational tools, or even creating personal AI writing assistants.

If you found this useful, stay tuned for Exercise 3, where we’ll begin exploring image generation using OpenAI’s image API!
